items.prompt: What does an order acknowledgment establish in the stated example?

options.text: All requested shares are already settled
options.why: Acceptance and settlement are different stages.

options.text: The venue has accepted the order under its protocol
options.why: No execution has occurred yet in the stated sequence.

options.text: A cancel request can undo all later fills
options.why: A cancellation must become effective and does not reverse confirmed trades.

options.text: The broker is always the final clearing counterparty
options.why: Roles depend on the execution/clearing arrangements.

items.explanation: The example explicitly separates acceptance from later execution and post-trade events.
